rejection_summary: Bulk (2025, tt36873832): failed string-theory experiment and shifting multiverse rooms provide strong weirdness, reality anomaly and rule-discovery material, but substantive whole-runtime reviews describe it as intentionally fragmented, repetitive and without clear revelations; the narrative is a meta-cinematic genre exercise rather than sustained scientific investigation, so it does not clear the 82 baseline threshold.

Frequencies / OXV: The Manual (2013, tt2414766): characters repeatedly experiment with the world's deterministic frequency system and uncover mind-controlling words, music-based countereffects and predictive equations, but the film remains substantially romance/philosophy driven with limited scientist/research-setting presence; deterministic baseline scoring stays below 82 despite strong rule discovery and concept escalation.

The Astronaut (2025, tt13964560): quarantine scientists investigate an astronaut's impossible survival, physical deterioration and possible extraterrestrial contamination after a failed mission, but whole-runtime reviews report a slow middle, familiar horror mechanics and an abrupt twist/resolution that leaves more questions than answers; insufficient sustained scientific discovery and payoff for the 82 threshold.
